newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down 1.3 percent in past week.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down 1.3 percent in past week.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index fell by 1.3 percent during the trading week from January 20 to 24, in higher trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said on Saturday.
The market's 31-share index closed at 540.38 on Friday from 547.5 a week earlier.
Volume traded during the week was 24.3 million dinars against 8.0 million dinars. Turnover in over-the-counter exchanges was 16.5 million dinars.
"The offer on the first market was much higher than the demand," a broker said.
BIAT bank fell by 23 percent to 30.6 dinars. Hotels firm Palm Beach was down 20 percent to 9.0 dinar.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT declined 5.2 percent to 82.44 dinars. Detergents firm SPCD and UBCI bank eased 4.0 percent each to 28.0 and 45.2 dinars respectively.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing rose by 33 percent to 29.94 dinars. ($=one dinar)
